summary: The follow-up/history milestone matches the approved scope: follow-up work items preserve parent job/session lineage, omitted follow-up tuples inherit the prior effective run tuple, jobs/runs/thread surfaces render that lineage clearly, and completion/blocker outcomes dispatch visible notifications.

checks.name: follow-up lineage and tuple inheritance
checks.notes: createFollowUpWorkItem() resolves the parent job, derives the prior effective run tuple when no override is supplied, and persists related work-item/session links on the new follow-up work item.

checks.name: jobs runs and thread surfaces expose lineage without a special transcript format
checks.notes: The inspection helpers render follow-up ancestry and related session ids directly from the ledgers, and thread inspection delegates to the existing SessionManager transcript lookup instead of inventing a separate always-on transcript store.

checks.name: follow-up and thread CLI surfaces are explicit and inspectable
checks.notes: The CLI exposes mu always-on follow-up <job-id> ... and mu always-on thread <run-id>, prints parent job/session references, and surfaces the effective provider/model/thinking tuple used for the new run.

checks.name: completion blocker and needs-user outcomes trigger visible notifications
checks.notes: Notification payloads are emitted only for completed, blocked, and needs_user terminal outcomes, matching the milestone requirement for visible completion/blocker notifications.
